name: Atria
summary: Competitor ad research and AI creative generation for Meta and TikTok in one platform.
best_for: performance marketers and creative teams that want competitor ad research and AI ad-creative generation for Meta and TikTok in one platform
skip_if: you don't run paid social at volume, or you only need ad inspiration (a cheaper ad-library tool) or only design (a general creative tool)
honest_knock: Two honest notes. It's credit-metered — AI credits and brand-tracking slots cap what you can generate and monitor, so a heavy user burns through Core's allowance and steps up to Plus. And it's specialized for Meta/TikTok ad creative research and generation, so it's a performance-marketing tool, not a general design suite. Its edge is competitor ad intelligence plus creative generation in one place; if you only need one of those, a cheaper single-purpose tool may fit.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, billed annually (a stated $360/yr saving), 5 seats
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 on their own pricing page, annual billing, which Atria advertises as 20% off) Core is $129/mo, a stated $360 saving a year. That covers 5 seats, 4,000 AI credits a month, 50 brands followed without AI insights, 5 connected ad accounts, $500K of ad spend analysed a month, 5GB of asset storage and 3 brand profiles. Plus $479/mo (a stated $1,440 saving): 8 seats, 10,000 credits, 100 brands with AI insights, 10 ad accounts, $1M of ad spend, 1TB storage, 8 brand profiles. Business $959/mo (a stated $2,880 saving): unlimited ad spend. Enterprise is custom. Extra seats are $20 each a month on every tier. Note the step from Core to Plus is far steeper than the tier names suggest — it is roughly 3.7x the price for 2.5x the credits.
